_comment: Golden (query -> expected tool) cases for the tool-search recall@k eval (RAG-MCP/ScaleMCP methodology). Queries are natural task phrasings, never name echoes. category: direct = intent stated plainly; paraphrase = synonym/reworded (harder for lexical BM25); filtered = uses the app pre-filter; distractor = targets the synthetic catalog. expected must be a non-hot tool (hot tools are excluded from search by design).
